comparison.objective: Join two chain ends on a connecting link and install a side-entry retaining plate.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual articulated-part alignment, hole-over-pin placement, lateral keeper insertion, and released assembly placement.
comparison.success_condition: Both chain ends seated, keeper stems in retained slot regions, chain on guide, joint in cradle, hands clear, and all bodies stable for one second.
comparison.reason: This tests multi-part insertion and latching of a chain joint. The candidate removes sacrificial tangs through impact fracture and debris recovery rather than assembling and retaining loose components.
